auto-fix.title: Automatic fix
auto-fix.description: Apply the fixes and open a pull request with them, when false the vulnerabilities are only reported. Can be set per branch in the .github/ghci.yaml file of the stabilization branch. Disabled by default, the Python dependency fixes are done by the Trivy dependencies audit

files-no-install.title: Files not to install
files-no-install.description: Dependency files that will not be installed

excluded-files.title: Excluded files
excluded-files.description: List of regex patterns for file names to exclude from the transversal dashboard and security advisories

dashboard-severity-threshold.title: Dashboard severity threshold
dashboard-severity-threshold.description: Minimum severity level to display on the transversal dashboard (low, medium, high, critical)

pip-install-arguments.title: Pip install arguments
pip-install-arguments.description: Arguments to pass to pip install

pipenv-sync-arguments.title: Pipenv sync arguments
pipenv-sync-arguments.description: Arguments to pass to pipenv sync

poetry-install-arguments.title: Poetry install arguments
poetry-install-arguments.description: Arguments to pass to pip install

java-path-for-gradle.title: Java path by Gradle version
java-path-for-gradle.description: Path to the directory that contains Java executable to use for the Gradle minor version

monitor-arguments.title: Snyk monitor arguments
monitor-arguments.description: Arguments to pass to Snyk monitor

test-arguments.title: Snyk test arguments
test-arguments.description: Arguments to pass to Snyk test

fix-arguments.title: Snyk fix arguments
fix-arguments.description: Arguments to pass to Snyk fix

project-environment.title: Snyk monitor environment
project-environment.description:
Set the project environment project attribute. To clear the project environment set empty array.
For more information see Project attributes https://docs.snyk.io/getting-started/introduction-to-snyk-projects/view-project-information/project-attributes

project-lifecycle.title: Snyk monitor lifecycle
project-lifecycle.description:
Set the project lifecycle project attribute. To clear the project lifecycle set empty array.
For more information see Project attributes https://docs.snyk.io/snyk-admin/snyk-projects/project-tags

project-business-criticality.title: Snyk monitor business criticality
project-business-criticality.description:
Set the project business criticality project attribute. To clear the project business criticality set empty array.
For more information see Project attributes https://docs.snyk.io/snyk-admin/snyk-projects/project-tags

project-tags.title: Snyk monitor tags
project-tags.description:
Set the project tags to one or more values.
To clear the project tags set empty dictionary.

trivy.title: Trivy configuration
trivy.description: Trivy scans: the container images of the ArgoCD applications, the Python dependencies of the branches, and the pull requests

image.title: Trivy image configuration
image.description: Scan the container images used by the ArgoCD applications with Trivy

enabled.title: Enable Trivy
enabled.description: Enable the container images audit, only applied to repositories that have an `apps/` directory of Helm applications

apps-root.title: Applications root directory
apps-root.description: The directory that contains the ArgoCD applications, `<apps-root>/<environment>/[<client>/]<app>/Chart.yaml`

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: The environment sub-directories of `apps-root` that are scanned, matching the directories deployed by ArgoCD

severity-threshold.title: Severity threshold
severity-threshold.description: Minimum severity level of the vulnerabilities to report and display (low, medium, high, critical)

ignore-unfixed.title: Ignore unfixed
ignore-unfixed.description: Do not report the vulnerabilities that have no fix yet

excluded-apps.title: Excluded applications
excluded-apps.description: List of regex patterns for application directory paths to exclude from the images scan

pull-request.title: Trivy pull request configuration
pull-request.description: Scan the pull request code with Trivy, reported as an action required check

enabled.title: Enable Trivy pull request scan
enabled.description: Scan the pull requests with Trivy

scanners.title: Trivy scanners
scanners.description: The Trivy scanners run on the pull request with the `trivy fs` command

severity.title: Trivy severity
severity.description: The minimum severities reported by the Trivy scans, as a comma separated list

ignore-file.title: Trivy ignore file
ignore-file.description: The path of the Trivy ignore file in the repository, the `--ignorefile` argument is added only if the file exists

config-targets.title: Trivy config targets
config-targets.description: The files scanned with the `trivy config` command, the command is run only for the files that exist in the repository

filesystem.title: Trivy filesystem configuration
filesystem.description: Scan the Python dependencies (poetry.lock and requirements files) with Trivy and fix the vulnerabilities

enabled.title: Enable Trivy dependencies
enabled.description: Enable the Trivy dependencies audit, only applied to branches that have a `poetry.lock` or a requirements file

auto-fix.title: Automatic fix
auto-fix.description: Apply the fixes and open a pull request with them, when false the vulnerabilities are only reported. Can be set per branch in the .github/ghci.yaml file of the stabilization branch

fix-severity-threshold.title: Fix severity threshold
fix-severity-threshold.description: Minimum severity level of the vulnerabilities to fix: vulnerabilities below this threshold are reported and ignored, not pinned, to limit the churn of transitive fixes (low, medium, high, critical)

dashboard-severity-threshold.title: Dashboard severity threshold
dashboard-severity-threshold.description: Minimum severity level to display on the transversal dashboard, the vulnerabilities below are reported on the output page in a collapsed section (low, medium, high, critical)

excluded-files.title: Excluded files
excluded-files.description: List of regex patterns for file names to exclude from the transversal dashboard

files-no-fix.title: Files not to fix
files-no-fix.description: Dependency files in which the fixes are not applied and not validated, the vulnerabilities they report are only reported

pip-install-arguments.title: Pip dry run arguments
pip-install-arguments.description: Arguments to pass to `pip install --dry-run` when validating the fixed requirements files

version-mapping.title: Version mapping
version-mapping.description: Mapping of version to the branch name

skip-hooks.title: Skip hooks
skip-hooks.description: List of pre-commit hooks to skip
